title: The Governor Fired A Freeze Cannon At Galo, And Then Revealed Who He Really Was . . . (highlight)
caption:
The governor fired a freeze cannon at Galo, and Galo just grinned. 🔥 Promare, one scene. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#promare #anime #animemovie #animerecap #animeexplained

segments.say: Galo grins straight into the villain's giant freeze cannon, and Kray just *laughs*.
Galo and Lio are stuck in one giant mech, fighting the governor's white *robot*.
Kray's weapon is the Absolute Zero Heat Death Cannon, built to freeze anything *solid*.
The cannon charges up, and Galo does not even *flinch*.
Okay, let's do it, he says. I dare you, you comet. Take your best *shot*.
Kray fires, and the whole world goes *white*.
Galo asks if they got him. Then somebody says, wait, *look*.
Kray is still standing, and he says the Burnish are destined to *die*.
Lio snaps. If you hate me so much, then kill *me*.
Kray only smiles, and then he unleashes his own *flames*.
He is a Burnish too, and he has been *hiding it*.
He says he saved little Galo by *accident*.
Then he sent Galo to the deadliest fires, hoping they would get rid of *him*.
Now Kray wants Lio as the engine's *core*.
The full story is on our page.
